title: Legacy Audit & Cleanup — Remove all vestigial shutdown/auto-commit/auto-push mechanisms
description: After OPS-SHUTDOWN-000 neutralized the active dangerous script, perform a full repository and macOS environment audit for every shutdown / poweroff / halt / pmset / osascript shutdown / sudo shutdown / auto-commit / auto-push / idle watcher mechanism. Delete or archive legacy scripts, strip shutdown calls from commitFailureMonitor.js and vercelDeploymentGuard.ts, and prove that no old shutdown path remains capable of triggering shutdown.
objectives: Search repository and relevant macOS paths for every shutdown/auto-commit/auto-push reference

Delete or archive legacy scripts: ai-worker/autospegnimento.sh, ai-worker/coordinator_watch.py, ai-worker/start_coordinator_watch.sh, ai-worker/README_WATCH.md, ai-worker/last_activity.json, the disabled auto-commit-push-shutdown.sh, test_shutdown_verification.sh, shutdown.log, shutdown_when_done.log, shutdown.pid
Strip shutdown calls from scripts/autoCommit/commitFailureMonitor.js and scripts/guardian/vercelDeploymentGuard.ts
Run a second search after cleanup and classify remaining references
Produce audit report and evidence log
success_criteria: All legacy shutdown scripts are removed or explicitly archived
commitFailureMonitor.js no longer calls shutdownSystem; it logs or exits instead
vercelDeploymentGuard.ts no longer calls shutdownSystem; it logs or exits instead
Second search classifies every remaining reference as intentional-doc, active-new-system, or false-positive
Evidence log lists every removed/deactivated mechanism and remaining references
dependencies: OPS-SHUTDOWN-000 completed and dangerous script neutralized

invariants: .windsurf/rules/50-shutdown-governance.md — only the Global Shutdown Manager may execute shutdown
forbidden_actions: Do NOT run git reset --hard or git clean -fd unless explicitly scoped to removed files
Do NOT delete unrelated project logs or data
Do NOT remove useful operational documentation without archiving
Do NOT leave shutdown calls in commitFailureMonitor.js or vercelDeploymentGuard.ts
Do NOT unload com.kurokasaiken.rpg-coordinator.plist if it is still used by the coordinator

files_to_modify: scripts/guardian/vercelDeploymentGuard.ts — remove shutdownSystem, replace with log/exit

integration_tests: grep -R for shutdown/poweroff/halt/pmset/osascript shutdown/sudo shutdown across repository returns only authorized references
launchctl list shows no shutdown-related agents
crontab -l is empty of shutdown/auto-commit/auto-push entries

notes.audit_scope: Search the repository root, scripts/, tools/, ai-worker/, .github/, coordinator/, package.json, and relevant macOS paths. Also search for synonyms: poweroff, halt, pmset sleep, osascript shut down, sudo shutdown -h now.
notes.commit_failure_monitor: The shutdownSystem function must be removed or made a no-op that logs 'SHUTDOWN_CAPABILITY_NOT_OWNED'. Do not leave a fallback shutdown path.
notes.vercel_guard: Same as commitFailureMonitor: remove shutdownSystem; deployment success/failure should exit with appropriate code, not shut down the machine.
notes.coordinator_plist: Only unload com.kurokasaiken.rpg-coordinator.plist if it is confirmed unrelated to current coordinator usage. If still used, leave it and document in evidence log.
notes.handoff: After this phase completes, the coordinator may queue OPS-SHUTDOWN-002 (registry).
